name: turbopress-monorepo
description: Turbopress (SpeedForge Engine) - High-Performance Zero-DNS WordPress Optimization SaaS & Client

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@turbopress/shared && npm run build --workspace=@turbopress/saas-app && npm run build --workspace=@turbopress/edge-api
scripts.build:saas: npm run build --workspace=@turbopress/shared && npm run build --workspace=@turbopress/saas-app
scripts.build:edge: npm run build --workspace=@turbopress/shared && npm run build --workspace=@turbopress/edge-api
